versos.hebraico: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל־שׁוֹשַׁנִּ֬ים לְדָוִֽד׃
הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֤י בָ֖אוּ מַ֣יִם עַד־נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
controles.kjv: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
controles.livre: Salva-me, ó Deus, porque as águas têm entrado e encoberto a minha alma.

versos.hebraico: טָבַ֤עְתִּי׀ בִּיוֵ֣ן מְ֭צוּלָה וְאֵ֣ין מָעֳמָ֑ד בָּ֥אתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־מַ֝֗יִם וְשִׁבֹּ֥לֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְנִי׃

controles.web: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
controles.kjv: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
controles.livre: Afundei-me em um profundo lamaçal, onde não se pode ficar em pé; entrei nas profundezas das águas, e a corrente está me levando.

versos.hebraico: יָגַ֣עְתִּי בְקָרְאִי֮ נִחַ֪ר גְּר֫וֹנִ֥י כָּל֥וּ עֵינַ֑י מְ֝יַחֵ֗ל לֵאלֹהָֽי׃

controles.web: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
controles.kjv: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
controles.livre: Já estou cansado de clamar, minha garganta enrouqueceu; meus olhos desfaleceram, enquanto espero pelo meu Deus.

versos.hebraico: רַבּ֤וּ׀ מִשַּׂעֲר֣וֹת רֹאשִׁי֮ שֹׂנְאַ֪י חִ֫נָּ֥ם עָצְמ֣וּ מַ֭צְמִיתַי אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־גָ֝זַ֗לְתִּי אָ֣ז אָשִֽׁיב׃

controles.web: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.
controles.kjv: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
controles.livre: Os que me odeiam sem motivo são mais numerosos que os cabelos de minha cabeça; são poderosos os que procuram me arruinar, os que por falsidades se fazem meus inimigos; tive que pagar de volta aquilo que não furtei.

versos.hebraico: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁמוֹתַ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא־נִכְחָֽדוּ׃

controles.web: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
controles.kjv: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
controles.livre: Tu, Deus, sabes como sou tolo; e meus pecados não estão escondidos perante ti.

versos.hebraico: אַל־יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ בִ֨י׀ קֹוֶיךָ֮ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֗ה צְבָ֫א֥וֹת אַל־יִכָּ֣לְמוּ בִ֣י מְבַקְשֶׁ֑יךָ אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
controles.kjv: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
controles.livre: Não sejam envergonhados por minha causa aqueles que te esperam, ó Senhor DEUS dos exércitos; não sejam humilhados por minha causa os que te buscam, ó Deus de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־עָ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי חֶרְפָּ֑ה כִּסְּתָ֖ה כְלִמָּ֣ה פָנָֽי׃

controles.web: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
controles.kjv: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
controles.livre: Porque por causa de ti aguentei ser insultado; a humilhação cobriu o meu rosto.

versos.hebraico: מ֭וּזָר הָיִ֣יתִי לְאֶחָ֑י וְ֝נָכְרִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃

controles.web: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.
controles.kjv: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.
controles.livre: Tornei-me estranho aos meus irmãos; e desconhecido aos filhos de minha mãe;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־קִנְאַ֣ת בֵּיתְךָ֣ אֲכָלָ֑תְנִי וְחֶרְפּ֥וֹת ח֝וֹרְפֶ֗יךָ נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃

controles.web: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
controles.kjv: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
controles.livre: Porque o zelo por tua casa me devorou; e os insultos dos que te insultam caíram sobre mim;

versos.hebraico: וָאֶבְכֶּ֣ה בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וַתְּהִ֖י לַחֲרָפ֣וֹת לִֽי׃

controles.web: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.
controles.kjv: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
controles.livre: Minha alma chorou e jejuou; porém mais insultos vieram sobre mim.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לְבוּשִׁ֣י שָׂ֑ק וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמָשָֽׁל׃

controles.web: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
controles.kjv: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
controles.livre: Vesti-me de saco, mas fui ridicularizado por eles num ditado.

versos.hebraico: יָשִׂ֣יחוּ בִ֭י יֹ֣שְׁבֵי שָׁ֑עַר וּ֝נְגִינ֗וֹת שׁוֹתֵ֥י שֵׁכָֽר׃

controles.web: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
controles.kjv: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
controles.livre: Os que se sentam à porta falam mal de mim; e os bebedores de álcool cantam piadas contra mim.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֤י תְפִלָּתִֽי־לְךָ֨׀ יְהוָ֡ה עֵ֤ת רָצ֗וֹן אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
controles.kjv: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
controles.livre: Mas eu oro a ti, SENHOR, no tempo aceitável. Pela grandeza de tua bondade, responde-me, ó Deus, pela fidelidade de tua salvação.

versos.hebraico: הַצִּילֵ֣נִי מִ֭טִּיט וְאַל־אֶטְבָּ֑עָה אִנָּצְלָ֥ה מִ֝שֹּֽׂנְאַ֗י וּמִמַּֽעֲמַקֵּי־מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.
controles.kjv: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
controles.livre: Livra-me do lamaçal, e não me deixes afundar; seja eu resgatado dos que me odeiam, e das profundezas das águas.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּשְׁטְפֵ֤נִי׀ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת מַ֭יִם וְאַל־תִּבְלָעֵ֣נִי מְצוּלָ֑ה וְאַל־תֶּאְטַר־עָלַ֖י בְּאֵ֣ר פִּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
controles.kjv: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
controles.livre: Não permitas que as correntes de águas me cubram, e que a profundeza não me devore, nem o poço feche sua boca sobre mim.

versos.hebraico: עֲנֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־ט֣וֹב חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ פְּנֵ֣ה אֵלָֽי׃

controles.web: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
controles.kjv: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
controles.livre: Responde-me, SENHOR; pois boa é tua bondade; olha para mim conforme tua piedade.

versos.hebraico: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵֽעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־צַר־לִ֝֗י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
controles.kjv: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
controles.livre: E não escondas teu rosto de teu servo; porque estou angustiado; ouve-me depressa.

versos.hebraico: קָרְבָ֣ה אֶל־נַפְשִׁ֣י גְאָלָ֑הּ לְמַ֖עַן אֹיְבַ֣י פְּדֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.
controles.kjv: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
controles.livre: Vem para perto de minha alma, e a liberta; resgata-me por causa de meus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣י וּ֭בָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִ֑י נֶ֝גְדְּךָ֗ כָּל־צוֹרְרָֽי׃

controles.web: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
controles.kjv: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
controles.livre: Tu conheces como me insultam, me envergonham e me humilham; diante de ti estão todos os meus adversários.

versos.hebraico: חֶרְפָּ֤ה׀ שָֽׁבְרָ֥ה לִבִּ֗י וָֽאָ֫נ֥וּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּ֣ה לָנ֣וּד וָאַ֑יִן וְ֝לַמְנַחֲמִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א מָצָֽאתִי׃

controles.web: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
controles.kjv: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
controles.livre: Insultos têm quebrado meu coração, e estou fraquíssimo; e esperei compaixão, porém houve nenhuma; também esperei por pessoas que me consolassem, mas não os achei.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּבָרוּתִ֣י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝לִצְמָאִ֗י יַשְׁק֥וּנִי חֹֽמֶץ׃

controles.web: They also gave me gall for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
controles.kjv: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
controles.livre: Deram-me fel como alimento; e em minha sede me deram vinagre para beber.

versos.hebraico: יְהִֽי־שֻׁלְחָנָ֣ם לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם לְפָ֑ח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִ֥ים לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
controles.kjv: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
controles.livre: Torne-se a mesa diante deles como que um laço; e aquilo que lhes dá segurança lhes seja uma armadilha.

versos.hebraico: תֶּחְשַׁ֣כְנָה עֵ֭ינֵיהֶם מֵרְא֑וֹת וּ֝מָתְנֵ֗יהֶם תָּמִ֥יד הַמְעַֽד׃

controles.web: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
controles.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
controles.livre: Sejam escurecidos os olhos deles, para que não possam ver; e que seus quadris vacilem continuamente.

versos.hebraico: שְׁפָךְ־עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם זַעְמֶ֑ךָ וַחֲר֥וֹן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ יַשִּׂיגֵֽם׃

controles.web: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
controles.kjv: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
controles.livre: Derrama tua indignação sobre eles; e que sejam tomados pelo ardor de tua ira.

versos.hebraico: תְּהִי־טִֽירָתָ֥ם נְשַׁמָּ֑ה בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־יְהִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב׃

controles.web: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
controles.kjv: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
controles.livre: A habitação deles seja desolada; e que não haja morador nas tendas deles;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּ֣יתָ רָדָ֑פוּ וְאֶל־מַכְא֖וֹב חֲלָלֶ֣יךָ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃

controles.web: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.
controles.kjv: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
controles.livre: Porque perseguem aquele a quem tu feriste, e contam histórias da dor daqueles a quem tu machucaste.

versos.hebraico: תְּֽנָה־עָ֭וֺן עַל־עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְאַל־יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.
controles.kjv: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
controles.livre: Conta como maldade a maldade deles; e não sejam eles agraciados por tua justiça.

versos.hebraico: יִ֭מָּחֽוּ מִסֵּ֣פֶר חַיִּ֑ים וְעִ֥ם צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים אַל־יִכָּתֵֽבוּ׃

controles.web: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
controles.kjv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
controles.livre: Sejam riscados dos livro da vida; e não estejam eles escritos junto com os justos.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭אֲנִי עָנִ֣י וְכוֹאֵ֑ב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
controles.kjv: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
controles.livre: Mas eu estou miserável e em dores; ó Deus, que tua salvação me proteja.

versos.hebraico: אֲהַֽלְלָ֣ה שֵׁם־אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּשִׁ֑יר וַאֲגַדְּלֶ֥נּוּ בְתוֹדָֽה׃

controles.web: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
controles.kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
controles.livre: Louvarei o nome de Deus com cântico; e o engrandecerei com agradecimentos.

versos.hebraico: וְתִיטַ֣ב לַֽ֭יהוָה מִשּׁ֥וֹר פָּ֗ר מַקְרִ֥ן מַפְרִֽיס׃

controles.web: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.
controles.kjv: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
controles.livre: Isto agradará ao SENHOR mais do que o sacrifício de um boi ou de um bezerro com chifres e unhas.

versos.hebraico: רָא֣וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ דֹּרְשֵׁ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וִיחִ֥י לְבַבְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.
controles.kjv: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
controles.livre: Os mansos verão, e se alegrarão; vós que buscais a Deus, vosso coração viverá.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־שֹׁמֵ֣עַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶת־אֲ֝סִירָ֗יו לֹ֣א בָזָֽה׃

controles.web: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
controles.kjv: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR ouve aos necessitados, e não despreza os prisioneiros que lhe pertencem.

versos.hebraico: יְֽ֭הַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ יַ֝מִּ֗ים וְֽכָל־רֹמֵ֥שׂ בָּֽם׃

controles.web: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!
controles.kjv: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
controles.livre: Louvem a ele os céus, a terra, os mares, e tudo que neles se move;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ י֘וֹשִׁ֤יעַ צִיּ֗וֹן וְ֭יִבְנֶה עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֝֗ם וִירֵשֽׁוּהָ׃

controles.web: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.
controles.kjv: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
controles.livre: Porque Deus salvará a Sião, e construirá as cidades de Judá; e habitarão ali, e a terão como posse.

versos.hebraico: וְזֶ֣רַע עֲ֭בָדָיו יִנְחָל֑וּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁ֝מ֗וֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָֽהּ׃

controles.web: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
controles.kjv: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
controles.livre: E a semente de seus servos a herdará; e os que amam o nome dele habitarão nela.
